findings.issue: 不正 (ふせい: injustiça, irregularidade, fraude) is not a science/matter term — the body itself lists it under 'Quantidade, falta e parte'. The same wrong grouping is repeated in the body checklist.
findings.current: Empregar termos de ciência e matéria como 物質, 物理 e 不正
findings.suggested: Empregar termos de ciência e matéria como 物質 e 物理

findings.issue: 同様 is a noun / な-adjective (adverbial only as 同様に), not an adverb. Only どうしても in the pair is an adverb, so the POS label is false.
findings.current: advérbios de identidade e insistência como 同様 e どうしても
findings.suggested: palavras de identidade e insistência como 同様 (substantivo/adjetivo-な) e どうしても (advérbio)

findings.issue: The accept list includes 風邪を防ぎます, which is a plain declarative ('vou prevenir'), not the requested 'Vamos prevenir'. It also contradicts the exercise's own explanation, which says ましょう is what produces the 'vamos' meaning.
findings.current: accept: ["風邪を防ごう", "かぜを防ぎましょう", "風邪を防ぎます"]
findings.suggested: accept: ["風邪を防ごう", "かぜを防ぎましょう", "かぜを防ごう"]

findings.issue: The section headed 'Ciência, matéria e física' ('Este grupo aparece muito em textos mais sérios') actually lists 舞台 (palco), 縁 (borda) and 筆 (pincel), which have nothing to do with science or matter.
findings.current: <heading level="3">Ciência, matéria e física</heading> ... 舞台 (ぶたい) - palco ... 筆 (ふで) - pincel
findings.suggested: Rename the heading (ex.: 'Ciência, matéria e outros objetos') or move 舞台, 縁 e 筆 para outro grupo.

findings.issue: Learner-facing title leaks internal production jargon in English ('batch'); the sibling lesson uses the pt-BR word 'lote' in the prose.
findings.current: Estados, materiais e ações: o batch fu continua
findings.suggested: Estados, materiais e ações: o lote fu continua

findings.current: Empregar termos de ciência e matéria como 物質, 物理 e 不正

findings.issue: The sentence announces 'estes três' but the list immediately above it contains four items (同一, 同時, 同様, 同化), so the count is wrong.
findings.current: Estes três se parecem na escrita e na ideia de "igualdade", mas têm usos distintos.

findings.issue: Untranslated English jargon 'batch' in a learner-facing pt-BR title; the sibling lesson uses 'lote' for the same concept in its prose.
findings.current: Estados, materiais e ações: o batch fu continua
findings.suggested: Estados, materiais e ações: o lote fu continua

findings.issue: The accept list admits 風邪を防ぎます, which is a plain polite statement ('vou prevenir'), not the hortative the prompt asks for ('Vamos prevenir'); it would be marked wrong by a teacher.
findings.current: accept: ["風邪を防ごう", "かぜを防ぎましょう", "風邪を防ぎます"]
findings.suggested: accept: ["風邪を防ごう", "かぜを防ぎましょう", "かぜを防ごう"]

findings.issue: 同様 is a noun / na-adjective, not an adverb (only the derived 同様に is adverbial); calling it an 'advérbio' gives learners a wrong POS label in a lesson that also teaches the term 動詞.
findings.current: advérbios de identidade e insistência como 同様 e どうしても
findings.suggested: palavras de identidade e insistência como 同様 e どうしても

findings.issue: ふと is written with the rare ateji 不図 inside a running example sentence; modern Japanese writes this adverb in kana, so the example reads unnaturally (the furigana itself is correct).
findings.current: <jp reading="ふとそらをみあげたら…">不図空を見上げたら、二つの虹があった</jp>
findings.suggested: <jp reading="ふとそらをみあげたら…">ふと空を見上げたら、二つの虹があった</jp>
